profile.name: FLUOR CORP
profile.industry: Heavy Construction Other Than Bldg Const - Contractors

intro.text: Fluor is dedicated to building a better world by applying our world-class expertise to solve our clients' greatest challenges. We deliver professional and technical solutions that emphasize safety, operational excellence and capital efficiency for our clients. Incorporated in Delaware in September 2000, Fluor and its predecessors have served clients for over 110 years, consistently supporting development and progress. We believe we are poised to continue helping our clients meet similar needs into the foreseeable future. Through our subsidiaries and joint ventures, we stand among the world's leading professional services firms, offering EPC and project management services.

lines.name: Cash and cash equivalents
lines.why: Cash can repay debt or be paid out: a financial asset. Cash needed to run the business is operating; move it if you know how much.

lines.name: Short-term investments
lines.why: Securities held for the cash they will return: financial.

lines.name: Long-term investments
lines.why: Securities held for their return: financial. A stake in another business that is part of operations is operating.

lines.name: Prepaid and other current assets
lines.why: Prepayments and other operating items: operating.

lines.name: Property, plant and equipment
lines.why: Assets used to produce and sell: operating.

lines.name: Goodwill
lines.why: Paid for acquired businesses: operating.

lines.name: Intangible assets
lines.why: Acquired technology, brands and customer relationships: operating.

lines.name: Deferred tax assets
lines.why: Taxes on operating income paid ahead: operating.

lines.name: Other non-current assets
lines.why: Other long-term operating items: operating.

lines.name: Accounts payable
lines.why: Owed to suppliers for operations: operating.

lines.name: Accrued compensation
lines.why: Wages, bonuses and benefits earned but not yet paid: operating.

lines.name: Deferred revenue
lines.why: Customers' payments ahead of delivery: operating.

lines.name: Short-term debt and commercial paper
lines.why: Borrowed money: financial.

lines.name: Long-term debt
lines.why: Bonds, notes and loans: financial.

lines.name: Deferred tax liabilities
lines.why: Taxes on operating income deferred: operating.

lines.name: Pension and retiree benefits
lines.why: Promised to employees for their work: operating (some analysts treat the unfunded part as debt).

lines.name: Other current assets, not tagged separately
lines.why: Total current assets minus the current lines above: current assets the company tags its own way. Operating by default.

lines.name: Other non-current assets, not tagged separately
lines.why: Non-current assets (total assets − current assets) minus the non-current lines above: assets the company tags its own way. Operating by default.

lines.name: Other current liabilities, not tagged separately
lines.why: Total current liabilities minus the current lines above: current liabilities the company tags its own way. Operating by default.

lines.name: Other non-current liabilities, not tagged separately
lines.why: Non-current liabilities (total liabilities − current liabilities) minus the non-current lines above: liabilities the company tags its own way. Operating by default.

s.t: For 2025, revenue earned from agencies of the U.S. government accounted for 17% of our total revenue.
Additionally, revenue from a single Urban Solutions' customer spanning multiple projects amounted to 15% of our revenue in 2025.
Revenue from a single customer amounted to 15 % of consolidated revenue during 2025.
Revenue from 2 customers each amounted to 10 % of consolidated revenue during 2023.

We excel at delivering large, complex projects in challenging locations, and as energy and chemicals work becomes more globally and geopolitically complex, clients rely on our expertise and proven global capabilities.

• The success of teaming arrangements and joint ventures depends on the satisfactory performance by our venture partners over whom we may have little or no control, and the failure of those partners to perform their obligations could impose additional obligations on us that could have a material impact on us.
We also rely on third-party suppliers to provide much of the equipment and materials used for projects.

Our business depends on the secure processing, storage, and transmission of confidential and sensitive information, including personal data of our employees, subcontractors, suppliers, business partners and clients.

The safety function we rely on to implement effective health, safety and environmental procedures throughout our company may be ineffective, and the failure to comply with such procedures, client contracts or applicable regulations could subject us to losses and liability.

Our ability to obtain such additional financing will depend upon prevailing capital market conditions, including those arising due to events occurring in our industry, as well as conditions in our business and our operating results; and those factors may affect our efforts to negotiate terms that are acceptable to us.

Our ability to service our debt will depend on our future operating performance and financial results, which may be subject to factors beyond our control, including general economic, financial and business conditions.
We rely on vendors to notify us in a timely manner of material cybersecurity in cidents, by virtue of the documents governing their relationship with us or applicable law .
Any future cash dividends will depend upon our results of operations, financial condition, cash requirements and such other factors as our Board of Directors may deem relevant.

Our ability to successfully execute strategic initiatives, including plans to monetize our remaining stake in NuScale, is subject to various risks and uncertainties, which may negatively impact the realization of expected benefits.
